say: You shall love your neighbor as yourself. Matthew twenty-two, thirty-nine.

key: Zacchaeus and the Sycamore Tree. In the city of Jericho, there lived a man named Zacchaeus. Zacchaeus was very rich. He had a big, fancy house, and lots and lots of money!
say: Zacchaeus and the Sycamore Tree. In the city of Jericho, there lived a man named Zacchaeus. Zacchaeus was very rich. He had a big, fancy house, and lots and lots of money!

key: Zacchaeus collected money from the people, for the king. But he took more than he should, and kept the extra for himself. So the people of Jericho did not like Zacchaeus.
say: Zacchaeus collected money from the people, for the king. But he took more than he should, and kept the extra for himself. So the people of Jericho did not like Zacchaeus.

key: One day, big news came to Jericho: "Jesus is coming!" Everyone hurried to see Him. Soon the street was full of people!
say: One day, big news came to Jericho: "Jesus is coming!" Everyone hurried to see Him. Soon the street was full of people!

key: Zacchaeus wanted to see Jesus, too. But he was short, and the crowd was tall. He hopped and jumped, but he could not see a thing!
say: Zacchaeus wanted to see Jesus, too. But he was short, and the crowd was tall. He hopped and jumped, but he could not see a thing!

key: So Zacchaeus ran ahead, down the road, to a big sycamore tree. Then up, up, up he climbed! Now he could see everything.
say: So Zacchaeus ran ahead, down the road, to a big sycamore tree. Then up, up, up he climbed! Now he could see everything.

key: Here came Jesus, walking down the road with His friends. Then Jesus stopped, right under the sycamore tree!
say: Here came Jesus, walking down the road with His friends. Then Jesus stopped, right under the sycamore tree!

key: Hurry Down, Zacchaeus. Remember Zacchaeus, up in the sycamore tree? Jesus looked up and said, "Zacchaeus, hurry and come down! I must stay at your house today."
say: Hurry Down, Zacchaeus. Remember Zacchaeus, up in the sycamore tree? Jesus looked up and said, "Zacchaeus, hurry and come down! I must stay at your house today."

key: Zacchaeus hurried down, as fast as he could. He was so happy! But some people grumbled, "Why is Jesus going to his house?"
say: Zacchaeus hurried down, as fast as he could. He was so happy! But some people grumbled, "Why is Jesus going to his house?"

key: At dinner, Zacchaeus stood up and said, "Half of what I have, I'll give to the poor. And if I took too much from anyone, I'll pay them back four times as much!"
say: At dinner, Zacchaeus stood up and said, "Half of what I have, I'll give to the poor. And if I took too much from anyone, I'll pay them back four times as much!"

key: Jesus said, "Today God's rescue has come to this house! The Son of Man came to look for the lost ones and save them." Who is the Son of Man? It's Jesus! Zacchaeus was lost, but Jesus found him.
say: Jesus said, "Today God's rescue has come to this house! The Son of Man came to look for the lost ones and save them." Who is the Son of Man? It's Jesus! Zacchaeus was lost, but Jesus found him.

key: Zacchaeus gave back what he took, and more! He shared with the poor, too. Jesus loves everyone, and His love changes hearts!
say: Zacchaeus gave back what he took, and more! He shared with the poor, too. Jesus loves everyone, and His love changes hearts!

key: For the Son of Man came
say: For the Son of Man came

key: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost. Luke 19:10.
say: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost. Luke nineteen, ten.

key: Jesus and the Little Donkey. Jesus and His friends were walking to Jerusalem, the big city. It was almost time for a happy feast called the Passover, and lots of people were on the road.
say: Jesus and the Little Donkey. Jesus and His friends were walking to Jerusalem, the big city. It was almost time for a happy feast called the Passover, and lots of people were on the road.

key: Near the city, Jesus said to two of His friends, "Go to the village over there. You will find a young donkey that no one has ever ridden. Bring it to Me. If anyone asks, say, 'The Lord needs it.'"
say: Near the city, Jesus said to two of His friends, "Go to the village over there. You will find a young donkey that no one has ever ridden. Bring it to Me. If anyone asks, say, 'The Lord needs it.'"

key: The friends found the young donkey, just as Jesus said! "Why are you untying our donkey?" asked its owners. "The Lord needs it," said the friends. So the owners let them take it.
say: The friends found the young donkey, just as Jesus said! "Why are you untying our donkey?" asked its owners. "The Lord needs it," said the friends. So the owners let them take it.

key: They brought the little donkey to Jesus. They put their coats on its back, to make a soft seat. Then Jesus sat on the donkey.
say: They brought the little donkey to Jesus. They put their coats on its back, to make a soft seat. Then Jesus sat on the donkey.

key: Jesus rode the little donkey down the hill, toward the city. Clip, clop, clip, clop! People saw Him coming. "Look! It's Jesus!" they said, and they ran to see Him.
